notes: ἐκ δευτέρου split rather than joined: the ASV writes three English words, so rule 94's precondition for one unit is not met and the preposition is left unrepresented under rule 34, exactly as rule 94 reads καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν.
κοίνου headed on common, the stem word of the denominal verb, following rule 66's made … meet and rule 91's support-verb test.
